title: Seedcamp (Carlos Eduardo Espinal) — 'Governance is the most powerful and most underappreciated force in business.'
summary: Seedcamp Managing Partner Carlos Eduardo Espinal MBE sits down with Eric for the European accelerator's Views series — framing Incorruptible as a blueprint for why founders give away their most important protections before they even realize it's happening.
